title: T.L.C.A.S.A.P.
lyrics_plain:
I need T.L.C.A.S.A.P.
Well, my muscles ache and my feet are sore
Thank God it's Friday and it's almost four
And time to hit the door
We're gonna spend the weekend on the lake
We've been working overtime and we need a break
And honey, I can't wait
We know how to spell relief
Got a good ol' fashion receipe
A little T.L.C.A.S.A.P.
A little R. n' R. for you and me
A guaranteed rat race remedy
A little T.L.C.A.S.A.P.
Take her books and read
And a change of clothes
I packed the cooler
and the Coleman stove
And the radio
We can boat on the raft in the sun all day
We can love in the moonlight hours away
While the crickets play
Work real hard six days a week
Honey, this is something we both need

A little R. n' R. for you and me
A guaranteed rat race remedy
